Finding more meaning often starts with small, intentional shifts rather than big life overhauls. Try noticing what activities make you lose track of time or leave you feeling genuinely engaged—those are clues to what matters to you. Connecting with people, contributing to something beyond yourself (even in small ways like helping a neighbor), and aligning your daily choices with your core values can all deepen a sense of purpose.

It can also help to reflect regularly: a few minutes each evening asking "What felt meaningful today, and why?" builds awareness over time. Meaning tends to grow from action and connection, so experiment with new things and pay attention to what resonates. Be patient with yourself—this is an ongoing process, not a destination. If you ever feel persistently empty or low, talking with a counselor can offer helpful support along the way.
